improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Meet Gideon, Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Instant AI answers, voice chat, and professional trade support. Try 3 free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the low entry price. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial and starting price creates urgency and transparency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business decisions. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a collaborative partner rather than just a tool, building trust with business professionals. The subheading immediately communicates three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while clearly stating the free trial offer to reduce friction and encourage immediate engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be prompted to choose a membership plan to continue. Memberships start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common conversion barrier—understanding what happens at the paywall moment. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining the transition, reinforces value with pricing transparency, and highlights the benefits of upgrading, reducing friction and supporting conversion.
